title: 02. Source of Truth vs System of Context

sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: The system responsible for the original business record.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: A school keeps official grades in its gradebook; a student’s summary does not replace it.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: A Drive file remains a Drive file after Knowledge OS reads it.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: Read-only ingestion observes provider content and permissions, then preserves evidence snapshots.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Keeping authority clear prevents a derived graph from silently becoming a competing business database.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: Systems of Record and the Source contract are distinct: one owns originals; the other describes the integration boundary.
